newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Romatex sees loss, to rationalise.
newsitem.headline: Romatex sees loss, to rationalise.

text.p: Romatex Ltd said on Friday it forecast a loss before tax for the nine months to end-June 1997 and major shareholders agreed that the only way to arrest the loss would be to rationalise the company's activities with those of Consolidated Frame Textiles Ltd.
The companies said in a joint announcement that in terms of an agreement with majority shareholder CG Smith Ltd a scheme of arrangement will be proposed to ordinary shareholders.
In terms of the scheme, the shares of all members of Romatex -- other than Confram and Santhold Investments Ltd -- will be cancelled.

In consideration for their shares, shareholders will be entitled to receive a cash consideration of 2.50 rand a share or a share consideration of five ordinary Confram shares for every 10 Romatex shares held.
A third option would be a combination of the cash and the share consideration.
Confram said it did not expect that the scheme will have any material effect on its earnings.
The companies warned Romatex shareholders to exercise caution in their sharedealings until they have received full documentation relating to the scheme.
